reason: I pick dinner from a reel the same day and my husband and I already double-buy; I'm not going to start scanning receipts every shop. Free is fine to look at, but I wouldn't pay for it.
objection: I won't keep logging every item I buy and use. A receipt scan is one more chore, and the app is only useful if I do it every time.
would_change_my_mind: If my husband and the helper were already in it and it just worked off the receipt with no manual fixing, I might try the free version and see if it stops the duplicate buying.
